Internal tech note for the thread: 

Summary of our recommended eval/regression approach for SummitCare clinical-assist: 
- Pre-deployment: split-sample test (n=10k clinical prompts representative of target distribution), metrics tracked: clinical-accuracy proxies, hallucination rate, safety-trigger rate, latency.
- Canary deployment: 1% traffic for 72 hours; automated monitor compares key metrics to baseline using pre-specified thresholds (statistical significance + drift detection).
- Continuous regression: stochastic sampling (0.5–1% of queries) with nightly batch evals against golden test sets; weekly snapshot regression for model families.
- Rollback triggers: safety/hallucination increase > 2x baseline OR clinically material degradations as defined in their acceptance criteria.
- Audit trails: per-token traceability and immutable event logs for inference requests (retention configurable per customer).

I've attached a short outline you can share: regression_plan_outline.docx. Happy to shorten into bullets for the one-pager.

—Ben
